say:0:1560219001:0.text: Magister! Chippy feels better after breaking this corn!
say:0:1560219001:0.source_cn: 主人！摧毁核心后，奇怪的感觉减轻了！
say:0:1560219001:0.male: Magister! Chippy feels better after breaking this corn!
say:0:1560219001:0.female: Magister! Chippy feels better after breaking this corn!

say:1:1560219002:0.text: The golem gets weaker as we break its cores.
say:1:1560219002:0.source_cn: 核心越少，巨型魔偶就越脆弱。

say:2:1560219003:0.text: Exactly. Let's fight the golem again.
say:2:1560219003:0.source_cn: 没错。一鼓作气，我们再试试挑战它吧！
say:2:1560219003:0.male: Exactly. Let's fight the golem again.
say:2:1560219003:0.female: Exactly. Let's fight the golem again.
